test_cache_helper: test the Cache class slicing, KV setting, and end index operations for Gemma model attention cache
create_cache_instance: create a Cache instance from a dictionary of layer data containing k, v, positions, and end_index arrays
slice_cache_by_batch_and_sequence: slice a Cache object by batch and sequence dimensions using bracket notation like cache[batch_slice, seq_slice]
set_cache_kv_at_slice: set key-value cache data at a specific slice using the cache.at[batch, seq].set_kv(new_cache) pattern
set_cache_end_index: set the end index across all cache layers using the set_end_index method with an integer value
